text:
maya: quick callout  i want to add a `criticality` field to runtime configs: values = [low, medium, high]. goal: drive approvals + rollout defaults in console.

alex: concrete differences between medium/high?

maya: high: 2 approvers required, default canary 1%, require rollback playbook link, audit entry mandatory. medium: 1 approver, canary 5%, telemetry gating enabled. low: no special guardrails.

sam: how do we actually block activation until approvals met? current console flow is single-approve or bypass.

nidhi: we can extend approval webhook to accept `min_approvals`. console disables activate until webhook confirms approvals.

paula: automation concern: infra services flip feature flags for maintenance. will they be blocked?

maya: we must support `service_account_bypass` with strict audit metadata (who, why, expiration). bypass only for named principals and recorded in the audit trail.

alex: telemetry gating: define precisely. is this a strong block or just a suggested stop?

maya: rollout proceeds to canary, but expansion halts if metrics breach thresholds. define `telemetry_policy` in config: metric name, comparator, threshold, window, evaluation_frequency.

sam: can we reuse the evals pipeline? we already compute latency/error per route.

nidhi: yes. runtime emits `rollout.event` containing config_id, cohort_pct, metric_snapshot. console subscribes and evaluates policies to recommend stop/rollback.

paula: API resolution question: with global defaults, env overrides, and route overrides, what's the canonical precedence?

maya: precedence: route override > env override > global. we'll expose `effective_config` endpoint that returns resolved values and a provenance list like ["route:checkout", "env:prod", "global"]. keep provenance as strings only.

alex: provenance strings ok but keep them short. we should avoid nested structures.

sam: need telemetry tags so we can attribute regressions to which override applied.

nidhi: runtime metric tags will include `config_id` and `config_source` (route|env|global). filters will work.

paula: deprecation / deletion safety: don't allow delete if active overrides exist.

maya: delete API either returns error listing active uses or marks record `pending_delete` and emails owners with 7d window. default behavior = reject.

alex: UI ideas: red badge for high-criticality, hover text explaining approvals and canary defaults, and a compact timeline of rollout events linking to metric snapshots.

sam: timeline should be interactive so engineers can click a canary event and view exact metrics for that window.

maya: we'll store snapshots for each rollout event; UI opens metrics with prefilled time range.

nidhi: add a `dry_run` rollouts endpoint that simulates traffic split + cost delta. ops asked for cost estimates before activating.

paula: include `estimate_cost_delta` per model/route in dry_run output. good to flag expensive changes.

alex: migration plan: how do we backfill existing configs into this schema?

maya: migration script will default to `low`. heuristics: if config touches routing/quota/caching -> mark `medium`. ambiguous cases -> add to `migration_review` list.

sam: can we provide a review UI that shows suggested criticality and owner approval button?

nidhi: yes: expose `/migration_review` API that returns candidates and suggestion reasons. UI can batch-apply or individual-review.

paula: SDK compatibility: adding fields shouldn't break strict validators used by some infra. we should ship server libs tolerant to unknown fields and update SDKs.

maya: also add a compatibility section in release notes.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature:config-crit-v1 rolled to staging 09:12 UTC. migration script queued (migrate-02).

sam: migrate-02 behavior? does it auto-update owners?

maya: it will tag heuristics and set `low` default. for ambiguous matches it flags owner and adds to migration_review. we will email owners for manual confirmation before prod migration.

alex: rollout checklist? ops-friendly steps please.

maya: checklist: 1) run migration script in staging, surface review list 2) enable console UI + dry_run in staging 3) run synthetic telemetry tests for gating 4) open 1% prod canary for 24h 5) expand to 5% with auto-monitoring 6) GA and enforce high-approvals

paula: timeline?

maya: target: staging migration tomorrow, UI toggles in ~72h, prod canary next week.

nidhi: i'll mock badge + timeline and PR UI flows. sam pair on dry_run test harness?

sam: yep happy to.

maya: i'll draft a short RFC + sample API schemas (add fields: `criticality`, `required_approvals`, `telemetry_policy`, `service_account_bypass`, `migration_review_id`). will link PRs. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: ticket CFG-2326 created: "config criticality + rollout controls" assigned to maya, sam, paula.
